messages:
maria_sales: Quick sync for Orion POC - they need Private deploy into their transit VPC, must preserve client source IP for audit logs, and have TLS inspect in their DMZ. They also asked: static EIP per AZ vs shared NAT cost delta. Need short checklist + talking points.

sam_se: Summary: doable. Preserve src IP if you avoid SNAT or use PROXY protocol. Options: interface endpoint (PrivateLink) + internal NLB w/ EIP on our side, PROXY header from their DMZ proxy, or allocate 1:1 EIPs. TGW-central NAT will SNAT and lose original IP.

leo_netops: Quick ops note: if they use Direct Connect -> TGW hairpin typical. Recommend PrivateLink for service traffic where src-ip matters. MTU note: with IPsec/encap use PMTU ~1400.

anya_sec: Security: TLS inspect ok if customer retains keys. We support mTLS on the connector and customer-managed KMS. Will draft SQ answers (TLS min v1.2, ciphers, mTLS flow).

sam_se: Pasteable firewall snippet for customer to hand to NetOps:

```
# Customer egress rules
Allow TCP 443 -> *.redwood-private.<region>
Allow UDP 123 -> 0.0.0.0/0  # NTP
# Optional inbound health checks from our probe IPs
```

maria_sales: Pricing ask: can we give a ballpark for per-EIP add-on vs NAT gateway?

sam_se: Ballpark: per-managed EIP add-on typically billed monthly per-EIP (order of tens to low-hundreds $/mo depending on region/contract). NAT approach cheaper infra but no sticky per-customer IP guarantee. I'll confirm numbers w/ finance.

leo_netops: Action items: Sam -> 1-pager comparing PrivateLink/TGW/peering + src-IP tradeoffs. Leo -> DMZ proxy + PROXY protocol snippet + MTU/keepalive ops note. Anya -> security questionnaire draft. Maria -> confirm customer preference and whether they accept PROXY header.

onboard-bot: Onboarding page updated: https://redwood.internal/onboard/orion-poc/connectivity

maria_sales: Thanks team, I'll share the one-pager after your updates. :thumbsup:
